impact: NVENC probe fails at runtime with NvEncodeAPICreateInstance status 15 (nvenc-api-create-failed:15). T-024 implemented the NVENC backend and unit tests passed (including nvenc_probe_available_when_hardware_present on RTX 4080 SUPER / driver 595.71.05), but the runtime probe in VAL-CAP-004 rerun 5 (2026-05-19T06:59:35Z) returned unavailable. encoder.selected was never emitted. Blocks VAL-CAP-004 encoder gate and T-021 green verdict.
resolution:
Probe-layer cause `nvenc-api-create-failed:15` fixed end-to-end across the 2026-05-19 Rounds 1–4 pass.

Root causes that were fixed (helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/ffi.rs and mod.rs, uncommitted):
1. Wrong NVENC version-word formula: `NVENCAPI_VERSION | (N << 31)` corrected to `nvencapi_struct_version(N) = NVENCAPI_VERSION | (N << 16) | (0x7 << 28)`, with the high bit kept only on the macros that require it (NV_ENCODE_API_FUNCTION_LIST_VER, NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS_VER, NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS_VER).
2. Local `NV_ENC_ERR_INVALID_VERSION` constant value corrected from 7 to 15 (SDK 12.1).
3. `NV_ENC_DEVICE_TYPE_CUDA` constant corrected from 2 (= OPENGL) to 1 (CUDA) — surfaced as `session-create-failed:4` (`NV_ENC_ERR_INVALID_DEVICE`) on the way through.
4. Six encode-path version constants (NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS_VER, NV_ENC_CREATE_INPUT_BUFFER_VER, NV_ENC_CREATE_BITSTREAM_BUFFER_VER, NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS_VER, NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM_VER, NV_ENC_LOCK_INPUT_BUFFER_VER) centralised in ffi.rs via `nvencapi_struct_version()` so the bug class cannot recur as parallel definitions.

Strict mode verification: `COVE_NVENC_REQUIRE_AVAILABLE=1 cargo test -p cove-replay-engine --test encoder_selection -- nvenc_probe_available_when_hardware_present --exact --nocapture` → PASS on RTX 4080 SUPER / driver 595.71.05. Probe reaches `ProbeOutcome::Available` and `encoder.selected` is now unblocked at the VAL-CAP-004 gate.

VAL-CAP-004 end-to-end has NOT been re-verified in this pass (T-021 rerun explicitly out of scope). Track that under T-021.

Full encode path (configure → push_frame → drain) is NOT yet green — `nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment` still fails with `nvenc-init-failed:12` (`NV_ENC_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_PARAM`). That class of failure has its own dedicated tracker now: see ISS-004 + T-025. Must land before T-010c smoke/RC.
